```{r}
#remove data points where the popup appeared  (14, 15, 16, 17) and practice trials (1, 2, 3, 4)
dat4 <- subset(dat4, !(TRIAL_INDEX %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 14, 15, 16, 17)))
bad_events <- c("sub1.1", "sub1.2", "sub1.3", "sub1.4", "sub1.14", "sub1.15", "sub1.16", "sub1.17")

dat4 <- dat4[! as.character(dat4$Event) %in% bad_events, ]
dat4$Event <- droplevels(dat4$Event)

```
```{r}
#table(dat4$TRIAL_INDEX)
plot_compare_app(dat4)
```
```{r}
dat5 <- interpolate_NAs(dat4, Method = "linear", XandY = T, MinData = 2)
plot_compare_app(dat5)
```

```{r}
dat6 <- baseline(dat5, BaselineWindow = c(-400, 0), BaselineType = "Subtraction")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(dat6, file = "FinalDat.rds", compress = "xz")
```
```{r}
ppl_plot_avg(data = dat6, xlim = c(0, 5000), Column = "Pupil",
             Condition1 = NULL, Condition2 = NULL, Cond1Labels = NA, 
             Cond2Labels = NA, ErrorBar = FALSE, ErrorBand=TRUE, PupilPreTheme = TRUE) 
```
```{r}
dat6$condition <- 0 #ini at 0
cond <- 'none'
for(i in 1:length(dat6$Subject)){ #for each sample in our dataset
    tmp <- dat6$SAMPLE_MESSAGE[i] #check whether there's a message
    if(!is.na(tmp)){ #if there is
        tmp <- regexpr( 'difficulty [0-9]+', dat6$SAMPLE_MESSAGE[i]) #check whether 'difficulty ##' is in the message
        if(!is.na(tmp) && tmp != -1){ #if so
            cond <- regmatches(dat6$SAMPLE_MESSAGE[i],tmp)        
            cond <- as.numeric(regmatches(cond,regexpr("[0-9]+",cond))) #set 'cond' to the type 
        }
    }
    dat6$condition[i] <- cond #and add this to the new condition variable that we added above
}
dat6$difficulty <- as.factor(dat6$condition)
dat6 <- dat6[dat6$difficulty != "none", ]

#now we can plot:
ppl_plot_avg(data = dat6, xlim = c(0, 5000), Column = "Pupil", 
             Condition1 = "difficulty", Condition2 = NULL, 
             ErrorBar = FALSE, ErrorBand=TRUE, PupilPreTheme = FALSE)
```
